title: Murder
text: Whoever commits murder shall be punished with death or imprisonment for life, and shall also be liable to fine.
plain_language: Killing a person intentionally. Maximum punishment: death or life imprisonment. Non-bailable.

title: Theft
text: Whoever commits theft shall be punished with rigorous imprisonment for a term which may extend to three years, or with fine, or with both.
plain_language: Taking someone's property without permission. Maximum punishment: 3 years prison. Bailable offence.

title: Voluntarily causing hurt
text: Whoever voluntarily causes hurt shall be punished with imprisonment for a term which may extend to one year, or with fine which may extend to ten thousand rupees, or with both.
plain_language: Physically hurting someone. Maximum: 1 year. Bailable offence.

title: Voluntarily causing grievous hurt
text: Whoever voluntarily causes grievous hurt shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to seven years, and shall also be liable to fine.
plain_language: Causing serious injury. Maximum: 7 years. Non-bailable.

title: Criminal breach of trust
text: Whoever commits criminal breach of trust shall be punished with imprisonment for a term which may extend to three years, or with fine, or with both.
plain_language: Misusing property or money entrusted to you. Maximum: 3 years. Bailable.

title: Cheating
text: Whoever cheats shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to three years, or with fine, or with both.
plain_language: Deceiving someone for personal gain. Maximum: 3 years. Bailable.

title: Rape
text: Rape as defined — punishment with rigorous imprisonment for a term which shall not be less than ten years but which may extend to imprisonment for life.
plain_language: Sexual assault. Minimum 10 years, maximum life. Non-bailable.

title: Criminal intimidation
text: Whoever commits criminal intimidation shall be punished with imprisonment which may extend to two years, or with fine, or with both.
